items.title: Norman Mason Interview, 1960-02-06
items.q: Did you ever know Richard Jones? Richard M. Jones?

ctx.x: I bet so. It will. As a matter of fact, I'm quite sure I wouldn't know anything about the place now. I know I was down in Miami in 19, the last time I was in Miami was in 1916, I think. And when I got back there, the papers had a big writer up there about the homeboy coming back and I remember I played the solo on the stage down there with the show, Masters in the Cold, Cold Ground. And I got quite a reception on that. But I got down, when I got down there, here about a couple of months ago, I couldn't even…
Did you ever know Richard Jones? Richard M. Jones? Richard Jones.
